hook_result_first: The opening frame shows the finished result before the video cuts back to how it was made.
str_overhead_process: A fixed overhead view follows the hands as they build or assemble the finished item.
pace_timelapse: A long process is compressed into a fast sequence of changing frames.
pace_stop_motion: Objects move in small jumps between still frames to create an animated sequence.
tr_paint_smear: A painted streak covers the frame and reveals the next shot as it passes.
tr_hand_cover: A hand covers the camera lens, then the next shot begins when the hand moves away.
txt_handwritten: Handwritten words appear over the footage as if drawn on the screen.
col_primary_pop: Bright red, yellow, and blue tones dominate the image.
aud_asmr_process: Close-up work sounds such as cutting, mixing, or brushing are foregrounded.
fmt_overhead_cam: The whole clip is filmed from above, with the work surface filling the frame.
hook_myth_bust: The first line names a common belief and immediately challenges it.
str_tutorial_steps: The video presents a process as a sequence of visibly numbered steps.
pace_slow_reveal: The camera gradually reveals the subject instead of showing it all at once.
pace_hold_long: A nearly still shot stays on screen long enough for viewers to inspect it.
tr_dissolve: One shot fades smoothly into the next instead of cutting instantly.
txt_lower_third: A small text strip labels a speaker or subject near the bottom of the frame.
txt_checklist: Checklist items appear one by one and receive visible check marks.
col_aqua_grade: The footage is tinted toward cool aqua and blue-green hues.
aud_voiceover: A calm spoken narration plays over footage of the subject or process.
fmt_carousel: A sequence of separate image panels is designed to be swiped through.
hook_mistake_first: The opening shot shows an error or imperfect result before explaining it.
hook_pov_text: First-person wording appears on screen to frame the footage as a point of view.
str_bug_hunt: The story follows a search for a specific flaw, bug, or small detail.
pace_jump_cut_talk: A speaker addresses the camera through quick cuts that remove pauses.
pace_freeze_frame: The footage pauses on one frame while a label or detail calls attention to it.
tr_glitch: A brief digital distortion interrupts the image to transition to another shot.
txt_label_callouts: Arrows and short labels point to specific objects in the frame.
txt_terminal_type: Monospaced characters appear progressively like text being typed in a terminal.
col_mono_accent: Most of the image is monochrome while one color remains vivid.
aud_sfx_blips: Short electronic blips and game-like tones punctuate actions on screen.
hook_countdown: The opening text starts a countdown that gives the clip a visible deadline.
str_challenge: The video sets a challenge and shows the attempt or result.
pace_fast_cuts: Many very short shots create a rapid montage.
pace_beat_sync: Shot changes land on the beats of the music.
tr_whip_pan: A fast camera pan blurs the frame and carries the viewer into the next shot.
tr_zoom_punch: A sudden digital zoom pushes into a subject to emphasize it.
tr_spin: The image rotates between shots to create a spinning transition.
txt_kinetic_captions: Captions animate word by word in time with the speech or music.
col_teal_orange: Shadows lean teal while highlights and skin tones lean orange.
aud_trending_sound: A recognizable currently popular audio track carries the video.
hook_overheard: The opening presents a short quotation as if the viewer has overheard a conversation.
str_day_in_life: The clip follows moments from one person's ordinary day in sequence.
str_behind_scenes: The camera shows work normally hidden behind the counter or away from customers.
pace_slow_mo: A detail is shown in slow motion so its movement is easy to see.
tr_snap_cut: A finger snap is matched to an abrupt change of shot.
txt_serif_caption: Small captions in a serif typeface sit over the footage.
col_warm_film: Warm colors and soft contrast give the footage a film-like appearance.
aud_lofi_bed: A soft, low-fidelity instrumental track plays underneath the clip.
aud_room_tone: Natural sounds from the room remain audible without prominent music.
fmt_photo_dump: A quick sequence of still photographs is presented as a casual collection.
hook_kid_voice: A child speaks the first line directly to the viewer.
hook_object_reveal: The opening hides an object and then reveals what it is.
str_seamless_loop: The final frame connects visually to the opening so the clip can repeat smoothly.
pace_rewind: Footage plays backward to retrace an action or return an object to its starting point.
tr_object_pass: An object is moved into or across the lens to reveal the following shot.
tr_jump_through: A person jumps toward or through the camera and lands in the next scene.
txt_kid_drawn: Childlike hand-drawn words appear over the footage.
txt_sticker_pop: Short text appears inside bright sticker-like shapes.
col_pastel: Soft pink, blue, yellow, or green tones give the image a pastel palette.
fmt_pov_cam: The camera sits around a child's eye level to show the scene from that height.
hook_question: The speaker opens by asking the viewer a direct question on camera.
str_before_after: A visible comparison shows the subject before and after a change.
str_parent_interview: A parent speaks on camera about a personal experience or result.
str_listicle: The clip presents a numbered or clearly separated list of points.
txt_big_number: A large numeral is overlaid to make a statistic or count the main visual.
txt_subtitle_bar: Spoken words appear in a consistent subtitle strip across the frame.
col_brand_block: Large blocks of the business's brand colors appear behind the subject or text.
col_natural: The image keeps the colors of available daylight without a strong color grade.
aud_interview_bed: A speaker's interview audio continues while supporting b-roll is shown.
fmt_reel_long: The piece uses a vertical short-video format with room for a 30-to-60-second story.
hook_cold_open: The clip begins in the middle of an action before any introduction.
str_one_take: The scene plays as one continuous shot without visible edits.
pace_speed_ramp: Playback speeds up or slows down within a shot to accent an action.
tr_match_cut: Two shots with a similar shape or movement connect through a matched edit.
tr_body_wipe: A person walks close across the lens, briefly covering it to transition scenes.
col_neon_night: Bright neon colors stand out against dark nighttime footage.
col_high_key: A bright, mostly white image uses soft shadows and light backgrounds.
aud_silence_drop: The music stops suddenly so the following moment plays in silence.
aud_count_in: Claps or spoken counts mark the start of the action.
fmt_split_screen: Two or more views appear side by side in one frame.
